title: US Tightens Chip Exports; India Sees AI Compute Opening
summary: The United States has tightened exports of advanced chips to Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore, and India&\#x27;s AI industry sees the restrictions as an opening to absorb spillover demand. Yotta says it will add about 100,000 GPUs over the next year, roughly a 10% increase over India&\#x27;s existing compute, though that is a stated plan rather than installed capacity. India currently has 153 data centers, ranking 14th globally; Reliance has pledged up to $110 billion and Adani $100 billion for AI infrastructure, while the country has long faced compute shortages and capital constraints.
